title: Cultivating Focus: A Gentle Journey

steps.text: Welcome, Blanca. Let's begin by finding a comfortable position, sitting or lying down, where you can feel relaxed and supported. Gently close your eyes if that feels safe and comfortable for you.
Take a slow, deep breath in through your nose, filling your lungs fully. Hold it for a moment, then exhale gently through your mouth. Let your body soften with each breath.
Now, bring your attention to the natural rhythm of your breathing. Notice the cool air entering, the warm air leaving. There’s no need to change anything, just observe.
As you continue to breathe calmly, imagine a soft light glowing gently at the center of your forehead, the space between your eyebrows. This light represents your focus, steady and calm.
With each breath, see this light growing a little brighter, a little steadier. Feel it anchoring your attention, drawing you inward to a place of calm clarity.
If your mind begins to wander, that’s okay. Gently guide your awareness back to the soft light and your breath, without judgment or frustration.
Now, picture yourself engaging in a task that requires your focus. See yourself calm, clear, and fully present, moving through each step with ease and confidence.
Notice how your breath supports your concentration, steady and unhurried. Allow this sense of focus to deepen with every inhale and exhale.
Remind yourself gently: I am capable of focusing. I allow myself to be present, one moment at a time.
Take a few more breaths here, feeling grounded and centered. Know that this calm focus is always within you, ready to be accessed whenever you need.
Slowly begin to bring your awareness back to your surroundings. Wiggle your fingers and toes, feeling the surface beneath you.
When you feel ready, gently open your eyes, carrying this sense of calm focus with you into the rest of your day.

safety_note: This session is designed to promote relaxation and focus. If you feel any discomfort or dizziness, please pause and return to your normal state. Always practice in a safe environment.
